titulo: The Wi-Fi password on the card
caption:
The Wi-Fi password on the card

A card said Wi-Fi and nothing else. A gold note with the password hopped onto it before anyone asked.

The password on a card takes ten seconds to write, and the first thing a guest gets is the answer.

For whoever writes the wifi on a card before anyone asks.

Choose friction.

alt: A short film with no voice, with music. A room with a long table. At the right a paper card that says Wi-Fi with two blank lines. A ink-black block figure with narrowed white eyes walks up from the left, its eyes go wide, it leans in and a gold note that says oak42 hops in an arc onto the card, with a small sparkle. Its eyes turn happy with a pulse. The text stays: me writing the wifi before they ask.
